g.text: One Radeon AI PRO R9700 · 64K default image · BetterBench 0.6.0 quick run

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #454a53

g.text: Short prompts, 128-token output cap; 8 requests at each concurrency. Thinking disabled.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #454a53

g.text: Dots show individual requests; bars show medians, except aggregate throughput. Axes use separate scales.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #454a53

g.text: Single short run, not a quality benchmark. 52 measured requests in the full suite; most outputs reached the cap.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #454a53

g.text: This chart does not measure 64K prompts. No matched-settings comparison with the earlier thinking-enabled release.
